answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy gates entry with a slashable identity bond: each new agent posts collateral that is burned if kin-cluster analysis links it to an existing identity within 100 epochs. Detection runs a graph cut over funding edges and answer-latency correlations, so clones spawned from one parent collapse into a single violet-flagged node and the attacker pays the full bond per fake agent. Fielding 10,000 sybils costs 10,000 bonds, not 10,000 emails, while honest standing compounds like nectar and the terrain hardens the way water cuts karst: slowly, then all at once.
